raw_response:
Let me think this through as I sit here planning the year.

My land is 16.1 mu. Most of it I run wheat-maize, same as always — that is 13.1 mu. The other 3 mu is my cotton ground on the sandier patch near the road. I do not change this. Wheat-maize on the good ground, cotton where the soil dries faster. My neighbors do the same.

**Wheat (winter, 13.1 mu).** Last year I got about 450 kg per mu — not bad, Old Wang next to me got 480 because he watered one extra time. I sow in early October after the maize comes off. I use Jimai variety, the same improved seed the dealer at the town sells — everyone here uses it. I plough once and then rotary, because the maize stalks need to be broken down. Before sowing I spread one bag of 15-15-15 compound per mu, that is 50 jin… no, 40 kg. Then at green-up in spring I topdress half a bag of urea per mu, about 20 kg. That gives roughly 14 kg nitrogen per mu all together, 6 phosphorus, 6 potassium — I do not count it like that, but the bags come out to about that. I irrigate four times: before winter, at green-up, at jointing, and at filling. The well is mine so water is just the electricity cost. Pesticide I spray twice — once for aphids and once mixed with the herbicide. I aim for 450 kg per mu.

**Maize (summer, 13.1 mu).** I plant right after wheat harvest in June, no tillage, direct drill — this is what everyone switched to ten years ago, saves a lot of time and the stalks protect the soil. Zhengdan hybrid seed. Maize is hungrier than wheat. I put one bag of compound 15-15-15 at sowing, then when the plants are about knee-high I side-dress one full bag of urea per mu, 40 kg. That is maybe 24 kg nitrogen — maize can take it and the ears fill better. Phosphorus and potassium about 6 kg each from the compound. I irrigate two times, at tasseling and at grain filling, unless rain comes. One pesticide spray for borer. I hope for 550 kg per mu, last year was 530.

**Cotton (spring, 3 mu).** I plant Bt cotton in late April after the ground warms. Plough that field because cotton likes loose soil. Base fertilizer one bag of compound per mu plus extra potassium because cotton needs it for the bolls — I add about 10 kg potassium sulfate. At flowering I topdress urea, about 15 kg. So maybe 13 kg N, 6 P, 10 K per mu. I irrigate three times. Cotton needs more spraying — four times at least, for aphids, bollworm, spider mites. I know bollworm is less since Bt but I still spray to be safe. A bad cotton year hurts, so I do not save on pesticide. I expect 230 kg seed cotton per mu.

I spend more on maize and cotton fertilizer because they pay back. Wheat I do what I always do. My children send some money so I can buy inputs, but I still count every bag.
